name: Alyj sharf
source:
Scarlet Scarf is a visual novel inspired by the legend of Plague Maiden.

Dive into the dark mysteries of a dying city with the fate of Sanator Richard Murdock in your hands.

Perhaps it's not too late to stop the on-going calamity.

[From [url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/650330/]Steam[/url]]
translation:
《猩红围巾》是一部受瘟疫少女传说启发的视觉小说。

深入了解一座垂死之城的黑暗谜团，将桑纳托·理查德·默多克的命运掌握在你的手中。

也许现在阻止正在发生的灾难还为时不晚。

[来自[url=https://store.steampowered.com/app/650330/]Steam[/url]]
